body:
It isn't that I didn't find his manifesto worthy of reading. I have it
printed to hardcopy--had it since it was published. I think of him more as a
scape goat than a criminal. But at some point, you have to focus on the
problems of the day and the people who the government are trying to screw
over now.

--
